customize.text: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, the Scribe of Scribes, the Ibis King. Once a Moon Envoy, he could have once stood among the gods, only to be defeated by King Deshret and brought into his service. Among the Seven Pillars, the Ibis King embodies the wisdom of King Deshret. He is exceedingly cunning, possessed of a formidable intellect and prowess for offering counsel to King Deshret. Within Sumeru's academic circles, some scholars believe that many of the desert's upheavals can be traced to this clever king. Certain texts record him as a flatterer and a god of deceit. After being imprisoned in Aaru by King Deshret, Thoth bestowed three "gifts": the power of "Deceit" upon the Tulaytullah noble Goudarz; the power of "Being Loved" upon the Tulaytullah royal heiress Makhaira; and the eyes of seeing through hearts upon a girl of the Shimti, Nefer. The long ages of torment have softened Thoth considerably, and his constant stream of jokes and witticisms now makes him seem notably more approachable.
